Women's Wednesday Road Ride (Sourland Cycles)

Hopewell, NJ · Road

Women's Wednesday Road Ride (Sourland Cycles) is a road group ride in Hopewell, NJ. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from Sourland Cycles.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: novice to intermediate. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @sourland_cycles the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Women's Wednesday Road Ride (Sourland Cycles) group ride

A friendly no-drop road ride for women, about 24 miles with 1,200 feet of climbing in the Sourlands. Beginners and seasoned riders both welcome. The shop also runs a women's no-drop mountain bike ride on the third Thursday of summer months.
